Description:
Ballistics of 115x728R 3UBM3 with the 3BM3 APFSDS-T shots, fired from the U-5TS tank gun (GRAU index 2A20). An analogous round without tungsten-carbide tip was issued as the 3UBM4 with 3BM4 projectile. Issued alongside the gun in 1961. 

Barrel Length:      5840 mm
Cartridge Length:    723 mm
Projectile Travel:  5117 mm  (estimated from above) 
Muzzle Velocity:    1665 m/s (provisional)
Breech Pressure:    3650 kgf/cm^2 (copper crusher gauge)
Chambrage:          1.37
Charge:             7.85 kg  DG-4 14/1 grains.


References: 
- 115-мм ТАНКОВАЯ ПУШКА У-5ТС (2A20) ТЕХНИЧЕСКОЕ ОПИСАНИЕ И ИНСТРУКЦИЯ ПО ЭКСПЛУАТАЦИИ, издательство «МАШИНОСТРОЕНИЕ», Москва, 1970
